description: Point-in-time S&P 500 constituent and adjusted daily-price baseline built without modifying purchased sources.

price_source.path: data/2026-08-05多个数据包_rethink/标普 500 成分股/标普 500 成分股-拆股及股息调整_20260804.zip

excluded_holdings.reason: US dollar cash is a fund holding, not an equity constituent.
The CONTRA HOLOGIC position is a corporate-action right, not a listed equity ticker.

membership_contract.interval_representation: 每个来源 member 可用行上 InIndex=1 的最大连续段。
membership_contract.left_censored: 第一条可用价格已在指数内，实际入选日期未知。
membership_contract.right_censored: 最后一条可用价格仍在指数内，不代表当前成员身份。
membership_contract.adjacent_transition: 0 和 1 出现在相邻的 XNYS session，成员边界可精确到首个 1 或最后一个 1 的交易日。
membership_contract.interval_censored_transition: 0 和 1 的观察行之间缺少 session，变化只能定位在 previous_observed_date 与 observed_start，或 observed_end 与 next_observed_date 之间。
membership_contract.point_in_time_use: Lag observed membership by one trading session unless announcement-time data independently proves earlier availability.
membership_contract.current_membership_authority: The dated State Street SPY holdings snapshot, not the last row of a historical price file.

identity_contract.historical_key: Each ZIP member is a distinct instrument record; preserve its filename stem and never splice versioned tickers automatically.
identity_contract.official_link: Link an official holding to a vendor instrument only by exact ticker in adjacent dated snapshots; retain the official identifier and the link method.
identity_contract.punctuation: Preserve official dots in canonical symbols (for example BRK.B and BF.B); public-source aliases belong to the later updater.

known_limitations: 历史覆盖最早只到 1990-01-02，不是自 1957 年起的完整 S&P 500 历史。
InIndex 是供应商记录的成员状态，没有公告时间或删除原因。
数据不含历史时点权重，不能精确重建指数收益。
复权 OHLC 只近似股息再投资，没有独立的现金分红和拆股事件账本。
供应商复权成交量不是交易所原始成交量，不得用于流动性或成交假设。
最新官方持仓若缺少历史包价格，必须继续标为不可用，直到用单独来源记录补齐。
